artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
local function round2(n: number): number
	local scaled = n * 100
	if scaled >= 0 then
		return math.floor(scaled + 0.5) / 100
	else
		return math.ceil(scaled - 0.5) / 100
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local rawChange = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local pct = round2(rawChange)

	local direction: string
	if pct > 0 then
		direction = "up"
	elseif pct < 0 then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Computes percent change from initial_value to current_value rounded to 2 decimals with up/down/flat direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need to report how much a value moved from a baseline and label the move direction.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	-- Check tool error first as required by the rules
	if listed.ok == false then
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sends = 0

	for _, c: CustomerRef in listed.customers do
		if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sends >= 10 then
				failed[#failed + 1] = c.id
				continue
			end

			sends += 1
			local text = "Hi " .. c.name .. ", we miss you!"
			local r = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			-- Check tool result before using other fields
			if r.ok == false then
				failed[#failed + 1] = c.id
			else
				notified[#notified + 1] = c.id
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists customers in a CRM segment and messages those inactive for at least a threshold, returning notified/failed IDs and count.
